typical_steps: Acknowledge the customer's frustration and apologize for the trouble or delay
Ask for specific details about the issue and the device being used
Instruct the customer to try troubleshooting steps via a provided link or device/modem reboot
Encourage reaching out via live chat or phone for real-time 1:1 support if issues persist
info_agent_requests: What specific trouble or issue you are running into
Which device or model is in use
Email on file and billing zip (for DM escalations)
when_they_escalate_to_dm: Agents escalate to a direct message when they need account-specific sensitive information like the email on file and billing zip, or to collect positive feedback/shoutouts.
never_promises: Exact wait times for chat or phone support
Specific dates for upcoming releases or content arrivals
Immediate resolution without trying troubleshooting steps first
